blocks.codex-worker:
(
F="$PWD/.claude-x-codex/<feature>"   # absolute, so the paths don't depend on where you cd
S=$(python3 "<plugin>/scripts/settings.py" env) && eval "$S" || exit
M=$(python3 "<plugin>/scripts/latest-model.py" codex "$CXC_WORKER_MODEL" --effort "$CXC_WORKER_EFFORT") || exit
blocks.codex-reviewer:
(
F="$PWD/.claude-x-codex/<feature>"; P="<plugin>/skills/run/references"
S=$(python3 "<plugin>/scripts/settings.py" env) && eval "$S" || exit
M=$(python3 "<plugin>/scripts/latest-model.py" codex "$CXC_REVIEW_MODEL" --effort "$CXC_REVIEW_EFFORT") || exit
blocks.claude-worker:
(
S=$(python3 "<plugin>/scripts/settings.py" env) && eval "$S" || exit
cd .claude-x-codex/wt/<id> || exit; R=../../<feature>/returns
M=$(python3 "<plugin>/scripts/latest-model.py" claude "$CXC_CLAUDE_WORKER" --effort "$CXC_WORKER_EFFORT" --project "$PWD") || exit
